title: Design forms
name: Name
submitHint: The employee taps this when finished.
prefixHint: Responses are numbered {{prefix}}-000001. You can change the prefix until the first publication starts. This example reserves nothing.
prefixLocked: The prefix was locked when the first publication was accepted, even if it later failed to complete.
prefixTaken: A form already uses this prefix. Choose another.
discardDescription: You will lose your unsaved changes and return to the list.
emptyQuestions: You haven't added any questions yet.
question: Question
removeDescription: It will no longer be requested in the draft. Previous responses are preserved.
changeTypeDescription: This will be a new question. Previous responses keep the original type.
previewHint: Illustrative preview. The official WhatsApp preview will be available when publishing.
previewEmpty: Add questions to see the preview.
decimalHint: The number is preserved exactly as entered. The server validates it when receiving a response.
previewOnly: This preview does not send or save responses.
emptyDescription: Create the first one to get started.
uncertainHint: We couldn't confirm the save. Check before saving again.
notConfirmed: The save may still be in progress. Your attempt is preserved.
expired: Recovery has expired. The attempt stays blocked; do not recreate a form based on similar content.
conflict: The form changed while you were editing. Review the saved draft.
reviewDescription: Compare the currently saved draft with your changes. Neither choice saves or combines changes automatically.
reviewPending: Choose what to keep for each difference before saving again.
retired: This identity cannot be kept: the question or an option has been retired. Your text remains in this review.
reviewLoaded: Read the current draft. Your changes remain on screen.
reviewFailed: We couldn't read the current draft.
busyLeave: Check the save before leaving. Your text and attempt remain in memory.
noSave: You no longer have permission to save. You can check your pending attempt.
optionRemovedDescription: It will no longer be offered in the draft; previous responses are preserved.
translations: Text is edited per language and is not translated automatically.
unmappedValidation: A value that this editor cannot correct could not be saved.
requestConflict: This identifier belongs to another attempt. Check the save; your request remains blocked.
sharedStructure: Types, order, options and required answers are shared across both languages.
prefixOriginal: The prefix is shared. Edit it in the original language.
previewMissingHint: Pending text shows the marked original; this reference is not saved as a translation.
optionsMissing_one: {{count}} option shows the original: translation pending.
optionsMissing_other: {{count}} options show the original: translation pending.
